content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Electric power and telecom service in remote Alaska; no natural gas or propane distribution business like the target."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Regulated water and wastewater utility; different utility product with no gas or propane business."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Regulated natural gas distribution to homes and businesses under state rules, though it also runs a large electric business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Upstream gas producer selling from wells and power plants; no regulated distribution or propane retail to end customers."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Regulated natural gas distribution plus propane delivery to homes and businesses in the Mid-Atlantic, closely matching the target."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Regulated gas delivery utility serving homes and businesses, alongside electric and steam networks that the target lacks."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Propane delivery to homes and businesses with appliance installation and tank service, matching the target's propane segment."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Midstream gathering, processing and transport for producers and petrochemical buyers; not utility or retail distribution."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Regulated natural gas delivery to residential and business customers plus home appliance service plans, similar to the target."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Oil refiner selling gasoline and jet fuel; a fuels manufacturing and retail business, not gas utility or propane distribution."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Propane delivery to residential and business customers with tank rental and appliance service, matching the target's propane model."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Primarily an electric generation and transmission utility; gas distribution is a minor part of the business."}]}
